description: This file defines the class Opencart.Admin.Model.Design.SeoUrl, which manages SEO URL records in an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It provides methods for CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete), filtering, and retrieving SEO URL data from the database, tailored to different store views, languages, and keywords.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: A model class for managing SEO URLs within an OpenCart admin module's design namespace. Facilitates CRUD operations and filtering of SEO URL data stored in the database.

methods.name: addSeoUrl
methods.description: Inserts a new SEO URL record into the database with attributes like key, value, keyword, store, language, and sort order. Returns the last inserted ID.

methods.name: editSeoUrl
methods.description: Updates an existing SEO URL record identified by seo_url_id with new key, value, keyword, store, language, and sort order.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrl
methods.description: Deletes a specific SEO URL record based on its seo_url_id.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Deletes multiple SEO URL records matching a key-value pair, optionally filtered by store and language.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all SEO URL records associated with a specific language_id.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all SEO URL records associated with a specific store_id.

methods.name: getSeoUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a single SEO URL record by its seo_url_id.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyValue
methods.description: Fetches a SEO URL record matching a specific key and value, considering store and language filters.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyword
methods.description: Retrieves a SEO URL record by its keyword, filtered by store and language.

methods.name: getSeoUrls
methods.description: Fetches multiple SEO URL records, with optional filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByStoreId
methods.description: Retrieves all SEO URLs associated with a specific store.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByKey
methods.description: Gets all SEO URLs matching a specific key and value, with optional store and language filters.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all SEO URLs linked to a particular language ID.

methods.name: getTotalSeoUrls
methods.description: Returns the total count of SEO URL entries, optionally filtered by certain criteria.
